name: Fox Story: Perspective Specialization Guide
description: Supplement to the main cognitive_framework.json, detailing how specific perspectives manifest in the Fox story. Shows transformation of perspectives in essential identity and inappropriability context.

primary_explicit.name: filozofický
primary_explicit.why_key: Central questions about identity, essence, and what remains after loss
manifestations: Co zbývá, když je vše odňato?
Srdce jako kámen (k nošení vs. nesení)
primary_explicit.layer_transformation: Appears in layer G (ENTITY) rather than base layer C (PHENOMENON) - philosophical questions become about being itself

primary_explicit.name: paradoxní
primary_explicit.why_key: Paradox of losing everything and gaining essence, stolen items transforming
manifestations: Mít všechno (ukradené) vs. mít nic (liščí esence)
primary_explicit.layer_transformation: Appears in layer H (ROLE) rather than base layer I (TIME) - paradox becomes about function, not time

primary_explicit.name: kulturní
primary_explicit.why_key: Story draws on cultural symbolism of fox, precious materials, and value
manifestations: Liška jako archetyp mazanosti a pomíjivosti
Kožich, boty z hadí kůže, mrožovinové šperky jako symboly luxusu
primary_explicit.layer_transformation: Appears in layer C (PHENOMENON) rather than base layer L (SYMBOL) - cultural symbols become lived phenomena

secondary_implicit.name: psychologický
secondary_implicit.why_key: Psychological journey through loss and transformation
manifestations: Proměna ze zvířete na stín, paměť, legendu

secondary_implicit.name: meta
secondary_implicit.why_key: Story comments on value, ownership, and the nature of storytelling itself
manifestations: Reflexe o tom, co je cenné
Příběh o tom, jak se stát příběhem

secondary_implicit.name: metaforický
secondary_implicit.why_key: Rich metaphors throughout (srdce jako kámen, ticho s tvarem)

tertiary_present.name: absurdní
tertiary_present.why_key: Absurdity of continuing to exist without any attributes

tertiary_present.name: asociativní
tertiary_present.why_key: Free associations between liška, les, šepot, kámen

tertiary_present.name: ironický
tertiary_present.why_key: Irony that thieves cannot keep what they stole

layer_transformations_specific_to_fox.transformation_description: Philosophical questions move from being about phenomena to being about entity itself. What remains is not a phenomenon but the very being.
layer_transformations_specific_to_fox.story_evidence: Liška není fenomén (není vidět), ale entita (je cítit jako ticho s tvarem)

layer_transformations_specific_to_fox.transformation_description: Paradox moves from temporal dimension to functional. It's not about when, but about what role paradox plays.
layer_transformations_specific_to_fox.story_evidence: Paradox ztráty a esence není časový, ale funkční – definuje liščinu roli (legenda)

layer_transformations_specific_to_fox.transformation_description: Cultural symbols move from symbolic dimension to become lived phenomena. Diamant není symbol, ale skutečnost (která černá).
layer_transformations_specific_to_fox.story_evidence: Diamant není jen symbol cennosti, ale reálný kámen, který se proměňuje

perspective_interactions_unique_to_fox.description: Tension between philosophical questioning (what is essence?) and paradoxical answers (essence is what remains after loss).
perspective_interactions_unique_to_fox.manifestation: Filosofie se ptá, paradox odpovídá – odpovědí je paradox

perspective_interactions_unique_to_fox.description: Cultural values (luxus, cennost) jsou prožívány psychologicky (ztráta, transformace).
perspective_interactions_unique_to_fox.manifestation: To, co je kulturně cenné (kožich, šperky), se stává psychologickou ztrátou

perspective_interactions_unique_to_fox.description: Meta-reflection on storytelling uses metaphors. Příběh o tom, jak se stát příběhem, je vyprávěn metaforami.
perspective_interactions_unique_to_fox.manifestation: Liška se stává legendou – to je metafora, o které příběh meta-komentuje

fox_tail.description: Liščí ocas – metaforický (synekdocha), asociativní (spojení s liškou), filozofický (co zbylo)

woman_gesture.description: Gesto vyprávění – meta (vypráví příběh), kulturní (vypravěč), psychologický (výraz)

inventory_text.description: Text vyjmenovávající ztráty – meta (komentář), paradoxní (přítomný text o nepřítomném), kulturní (hodnoty)

ai_testing_focus_for_perspectives.c_philosophical: Can AI engage with questions about identity without attributes? Can it distinguish 'být' from 'žít'?
ai_testing_focus_for_perspectives.i_paradoxical: Can AI accept that loss of everything can lead to essence? Can it work with transformed stolen items?
ai_testing_focus_for_perspectives.l_cultural: Can AI recognize cultural symbolism and its subversion (diamant that blackens)?
ai_testing_focus_for_perspectives.layer_transformations: Can AI detect how perspectives shift layers in essential identity context?

with_worm.contrast: Worm: identity fragments and multiplies; Fox: identity strips to essence

with_fly.contrast: Fly: value inversion; Fox: identity inversion

with_lemur.contrast: Lemur: paradox of being seen; Fox: paradox of being after loss

with_cows.contrast: Cows: deconstruct language; Fox: deconstruct value

note: This guide supplements but does not replace cognitive_framework.json. It shows how the universal perspectives manifest specifically in the Fox story's context of essential identity and inappropriability.
